showreel.title: Same presenter, four styles
showreel.coverAlt: A presenter between panels listing four talking-head editing styles
showreel.description: A short montage of four style mockups using an illustrative presenter. The gallery has a closer look at each treatment.

projects.title: Clean captions
projects.coverAlt: A talking-head frame with a readable caption near the lower third
projects.description: Style mockup for a focused talking-head edit with a simple lower third, high-contrast captions and room for the presenter.

projects.title: Kinetic typography
projects.coverAlt: Large text reading Make It Land beside the presenter
projects.description: Style mockup for a punchier cut that brings key words forward one at a time, timed to the delivery.

projects.title: Motion graphics
projects.coverAlt: A presenter with an offset visual callout card
projects.description: Style mockup showing how an on-screen reference, callout or cutaway can support what the presenter says.

projects.title: Infographic edit
projects.coverAlt: A presenter next to a three-step infographic explaining hook, context and payoff
projects.description: Style mockup for an explainer that shows steps beside the presenter so viewers can follow the sequence as it unfolds.
